result.instructions: Tools for ComplyCube, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our clients still have an attention outcome on their checks?"; "Create a company client for Acme Ltd and run an extensive AML screening on it."; "Show me the result of the AML screening check we ran for client 5eb04fcd0f3e360008035eb1.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ComplyCube data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run complycube_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run complycube_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run complycube_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. complycube_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: complycube_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients (people or companies) on the account, newest first. Each client has an id, type, contact details and metadata. Use this to find a client id before running a check. ComplyCube API: GET /v1/clients.

email.description: Only clients with this email address.

externalId.description: Only clients with this external id (your own customer id).

createdAfter.description: Only clients created after this time (ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

createdBefore.description: Only clients created before this time (ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: complycube_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client by id: type, contact details, personal details or company details, metadata and timestamps. ComplyCube API: GET /v1/clients/{clientId}.

tools.name: complycube_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client record before running checks on it. Give personDetails for type person, or companyDetails for type company. Store only the fields the checks need. The new client id comes back in the reply. ComplyCube API: POST /v1/clients.

email.description: The client's email address (required by ComplyCube).

externalId.description: Your own id for this client. Uniqueness is not enforced.

joinedDate.description: The date the client joined (yyyy-mm-dd), for migrated clients.

tools.name: complycube_list_checks
tools.title: List checks
tools.description: List checks (identity, document, AML screening and others), newest first. Filter by client, check type, status (pending, complete, failed) or outcome (clear, attention, not_processed, rejected). ComplyCube API: GET /v1/checks.

clientId.description: Only checks for this client id.

type.description: Only checks of this type, for example standard_screening_check.

outcome.description: Only checks with this result outcome.

createdAfter.description: Only checks created after this time (ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

createdBefore.description: Only checks created before this time (ISO 8601 date-time, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: complycube_get_check
tools.title: Get a check
tools.description: Get one check by id: its type, client, status, and the result (outcome and the breakdown of each part). Use it to read the result of a screening check after it completes. ComplyCube API: GET /v1/checks/{checkId}.

tools.name: complycube_create_aml_check
tools.title: Run an AML screening check
tools.description: Start an AML screening check for an existing client: sanctions, PEP and watchlist screening. Standard is the basic screen; extensive is the full screen. The check runs in the background and counts against the account's monthly check quota. Read the result later with complycube_get_check. ComplyCube API: POST /v1/checks.
